findings.title: Hard-coded AWS access key committed to source
findings.evidence: A new module-level constant embeds an AWS access key directly in the repository, making the credential available to anyone with source access and likely to logs, artifacts, and forks.
findings.recommendation: Remove the hard-coded key from the codebase, rotate the exposed credential immediately, and load AWS credentials from the standard boto3 provider chain or a secure secret manager/environment variable instead.
